propositions: Dependabot PR #131 must be landed via Gerrit (GitHub is read-only) and then closed after the mirror syncs with the merged commit.
Five packages must be updated: botocore, genai-prices, json-repair, mypy, and ruff; the lock is regenerated with uv workflow to resolve current versions, not pinned to PR's stale pins.
New ruff 0.16.3 and mypy 2.3.1 must pass all lint, typecheck, and test gates with zero source code changes; no suppressions (noqa, type: ignore) are added.
Complexity baseline scoring must remain unchanged (new=0, increased=0, stale=0) and .github/complexity-baseline.json must not be edited.
PR #131 must be verified closed after Gerrit merge lands to main, either by dependabot auto-close or manual close with cross-reference to the merged change.
